statement: A general ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine covering the entire front line, confirmed by both governments and declared for at least 7 days or indefinitely, takes effect between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, BBC and AFP report that Moscow and Kyiv both confirmed a front-wide ceasefire of at least 7 days or open-ended duration taking effect between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-30; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No front-wide ceasefire of at least 7 days confirmed by both Moscow and Kyiv takes effect between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-30.

statement: At least one merchant vessel is damaged or sunk by a drone, missile or naval mine strike in the Black Sea or at one of its ports between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of Reuters, AP, BBC and AFP report a merchant vessel damaged or sunk by drone, missile or mine in the Black Sea or its ports between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No merchant vessel is damaged or sunk by a drone, missile or mine strike in the Black Sea or its ports between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13.

statement: The 10-year US Treasury constant maturity yield (FRED series DGS10) for 2026-11-13 is below 5.00 percent. Reference: 5.21 percent on the packet date 2026-10-13.
resolution: TRUE if the FRED DGS10 observation for 2026-11-13 is below 5.00 percent; FALSE if it is 5.00 percent or higher. Reference: 5.21 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield for 2026-11-13 is at or above 5.00 percent.

statement: The ICE Brent crude futures contract for December 2026 settles below 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-28. Reference: front-month Brent at 105.86 on the packet date 2026-10-13.
resolution: TRUE if the official ICE settlement price of the Brent December 2026 contract on 2026-10-28 is below 100.00 USD per barrel; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 105.86 on the packet date.
failure_condition: The Brent December 2026 contract settles at or above 100.00 USD per barrel on 2026-10-28.

statement: The Nasdaq Composite records at least one daily close below 26,000.00 between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13. Reference: 27,190.34 on the packet date 2026-10-13.
resolution: TRUE if FRED series NASDAQCOM shows a daily close below 26,000.00 on any trading day between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13; otherwise FALSE. Reference: 27,190.34 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every Nasdaq Composite daily close between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13 is at or above 26,000.00.

statement: CISA adds at least one GitLab vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-14 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV catalog contains at least one entry whose vendorProject is GitLab and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-10-14 and 2026-12-31; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No GitLab vulnerability is added to the CISA KEV catalog with a date-added value between 2026-10-14 and 2026-12-31.

statement: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns or is removed as US ambassador to Greece, with the departure confirmed by her, the White House or the State Department between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if at least two of AP, Reuters, CNBC, the Guardian and BBC report confirmation by Guilfoyle, the White House or the State Department, made between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13, that she resigned or was removed as ambassador; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: Kimberly Guilfoyle neither resigns nor is removed as US ambassador to Greece between 2026-10-13 and 2026-11-13.

statement: Democratic candidates win at least 218 of the 435 US House seats in the general election held on 2026-11-03.
resolution: TRUE if Associated Press race calls as of 2026-12-18 show Democratic candidates winning at least 218 House seats in the 2026-11-03 election; FALSE if they show 217 or fewer.
failure_condition: Democratic candidates win 217 or fewer US House seats in the 2026-11-03 election.

statement: A guilty verdict or guilty plea on at least one count is entered in the federal hate crimes case over the 2022 Buffalo supermarket shooting (United States v. Gendron, Western District of New York) between 2026-10-14 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: TRUE if the Western District of New York docket for United States v. Gendron shows a guilty verdict or guilty plea on at least one count entered between 2026-10-14 and 2027-01-29; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No guilty verdict or guilty plea on any federal count is entered in United States v. Gendron between 2026-10-14 and 2027-01-29.

statement: The USGS catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 200 km of the epicenter of the M 7.7 Panama earthquake (USGS event us6000u18k), with origin time between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13 UTC.
resolution: TRUE if a USGS ComCat query returns at least one event of magnitude 6.0 or greater within 200 km of the us6000u18k epicenter with origin time between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13 UTC; otherwise FALSE.
failure_condition: No earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater occurs within 200 km of the M 7.7 Panama epicenter between 2026-10-14 and 2026-11-13 UTC.
